Getting to Chiang Khan Walking Street from Chiang Mai

From Chiang Mai

Mode: Drive / bus Duration: About 5–6 hours
  • Head south on Route 1 via Phitsanulok toward Loei
  • From Loei continue northeast to Chiang Khan
